rationale: The Court is most likely to resolve the case on a trigger-mechanics reading of “single function of the trigger,” reinforced by separation-of-powers and fair-notice concerns in a criminally operative definition, with lenity as a backstop. Expect at least one separate writing to sharpen the lenity/no-deference point (Thomas or Gorsuch) and a principal dissent (Alito, possibly joined by Sotomayor) emphasizing the shooter-facing, practical operation of bump stocks.
